title: SM AC10C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine AC10C excitation system including an automatic voltage regulator and an exciter, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator gain, K_R (pu)}, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_B1 (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_C1 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_B2 (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_C2 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_UB1 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lag time constant, {UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_UC1 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lead time constant, {UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_UB2 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lag time constant, {UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_UC2 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lead time constant, {OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_OB1 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lag time constant, {OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_OC1 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lead time constant, {OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_OB2 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lag time constant, {OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_OC2 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lead time constant, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Maximum PSS regulator output, V_RSmax (pu)}, {Minimum PSS regulator output, V_RSmin (pu)}, {Exciter field current regulator measurement time constant, T_EXC (s)} sets the measurement time constant of exciter field current, {Exciter field current regulator feedback gain, K_EXC (pu)} sets the feedback gain of exciter field current, {Exciter field current regulator proportional gain, K_CR (pu)} sets the proportional gain of exciter field current, {Exciter field current regulator feedback selector SW_EXC} sets the exciter field current regulator feedback selector Position A: feedback from generator field, {Exciter field current regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_F1 (s)} sets the lead time constant in exciter field current, {Exciter field current regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_F2 (s)} sets the lag time constant in exciter field current, {Exciter field current limiter feedback gain, K_VFE (pu)} sets the exciter field current limiter gain, {Exciter field current limiter proportional gain, K_LIM (pu)} sets the exciter field current proportional gain, {Exciter field current limiter reference, V_FELIM (pu)} sets the reference of field current limiter of excitation, {Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} sets the pSS input location Voltage error or after take-over, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location Take-over at voltage, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location Take-over at voltage, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location Take-over at voltage, {Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} sets the exciter field gain, {Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances, K_D (pu)} sets the demagnetization factor, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} sets the first saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} sets the first saturation lookup voltage, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} sets the second saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} sets the second saturation lookup voltage, {Maximum exciter field current, V_FEmax (pu)} sets the exciter upper limit, {Minimum exciter voltage output limit, V_Emin (pu)} sets the exciter lower limit, {Potential circuit gain coefficient, K_P (pu)}, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C1 (pu)}, {Power source selector SW1} sets the power source selector Position B: power source independent of the terminal, {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B1max (pu)} sets the maximum available exciter field voltage, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C2 (pu)}, {Additive potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I2 (pu)} sets the additive circuit current gain coefficient and {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B2max (pu)}. Values come from the instance.
